subject.title: refactor(qqbot): adopt core typing keepalive loop with budget accounting intact

question: Should `createTypingKeepaliveLoop` become a supported public plugin SDK contract during the channel program's API-neutral mechanical-adoption phase?
rationale: The implementation is reusable, but its permanent third-party lifecycle contract cannot be selected from code correctness alone.

options.title: Keep Phase 1 API-neutral
options.body: Remove the public export and route QQBot through a narrow bundled or injected runtime seam.

options.title: Sponsor the public API
options.body: Approve the export with documented lifecycle semantics, direct SDK contract tests, and explicit compatibility ownership.

options.title: Defer the refactor
options.body: Retain QQBot's local scheduler until the planned channel contract phase defines the permanent seam.

recommendation.title: Keep Phase 1 API-neutral
recommendation.body: Remove the public export and route QQBot through a narrow bundled or injected runtime seam.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked phased program and relevant feature history make Peter Steinberger the strongest available owner for this API-direction choice.
